# Method GetImporterOptions

#### GetImporterOptions(int)

Gets the options of an importer.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 8, 0, 0)]
List<KeyValue> GetImporterOptions(int inImporterIx)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  int |  inImporterIx |  Index of importer to analyze, within [0, ImporterCount-1].  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  List<KeyValue> |  Importer options.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.8.
